envelope.description: Add assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding + DiffGroundingDeps (working-tree diff, HEAD^ fallback)

body.title: Add assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding + DiffGroundingDeps (working-tree diff, HEAD^ fallback)
body.summary: In src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts add assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding(repoPath, deps?) — a peer of assembleCodeReviewGrounding — plus a DiffGroundingDeps seam (workingTreeDiff + lastCommitDiff over the git_diff builtin) and a real default. It derives the changed set from the working-tree diff; when that is empty it falls back to gitDiffTool { from:'HEAD^' } (last commit); when HEAD has no parent it falls back to the root commit's contents; and it emits a CodeReviewGrounding whose symbols[] is one per-file pseudo-ChangedSymbolSummary (kind:'file', name:file, hunks in signature, empty edges; a binary marker where no textual hunks). Returns { grounding, changedFiles }. Read-only; hunks bounded by git_diff maxBytes. An empty result is a valid grounding (symbols:[]), not an error; a git failure on BOTH paths propagates.
acceptanceChecks: assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding(repoPath, deps?) returns { grounding, changedFiles } with one pseudo-ChangedSymbolSummary per changed file
non-empty working tree uses the working-tree diff and does NOT call the HEAD^ seam
empty working tree falls back to { from:'HEAD^' }; HEAD-with-no-parent falls back to the root commit; both-empty yields symbols:[]
a binary changed file yields a pseudo-symbol with a binary marker (no hunks) still present in changedFiles
the assembler is read-only (never mutates / reindexes / commits) and a both-paths git failure propagates

tests.name: assembler: working tree NON-empty -> one row per working-tree changed file (kind:'file', name:file, hunks in signature); HEAD^ seam NOT called
assembler: working tree EMPTY -> falls back to { from:'HEAD^' } diff; symbols reflect the last commit's changed files
assembler: a binary changed file -> a pseudo-symbol with a binary marker (no hunks), still present in changedFiles
assembler: both working-tree and HEAD^ empty -> a valid grounding with symbols:[] (no crash)
assembler: a truncated GitDiffData still yields a valid grounding (bounded hunks, review proceeds, no crash)
assembler: neither git call mutates (the injected git seam is read-only; no reindex/commit invoked)
assembler: a clean-working-tree fixture repo with one commit -> real gitDiffTool returns the last commit's changed files + hunks via the HEAD^ fallback
